method: Temporary Rust executable linked to the current production core with thin LTO. Calls windows::open_recycle_bin and reads C drive Recycle Bin summaries before and after. No synthetic activation response.
scope: Shell activation request succeeded. No window inspection or computer use. No bin item was created, deleted, restored or emptied by the probe. Frontend click path and populated-bin manual acceptance are separate.
probeSource: fn main() { let before = voldiq_core::windows::recycle_bin::query("C:\\").ok(); match voldiq_core::windows::open_recycle_bin() { Ok(()) => { let after = voldiq_core::windows::recycle_bin::query("C:\\").ok(); println!("activation=success; before={before:?}; after={after:?}"); }, Err(error) => { eprintln!("{error}"); std::process::exit(1); } } }
